name: Miyamoto Ruri
source: She is Kosaki Onodera's best friend and is one of the few people who knows about Onodera's feelings for Ichijou. She constantly tries to help Kosaki admit her feelings for Raku. Ruri soon found her own love in Shuu and confessed her feelings to him near the end of the manga. They became a couple and are seen living together in the final chapter.
